title: Diagonal matrix normal form for a residue rank-one kernel
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, X and Y finite projective R-modules, f:X→Y linear, and p a prime. Put A=R_p and κ=A/m. Suppose ker(f⊗κ) is linearly isomorphic to κ. There exist A-modules U,C, an A-linear map g:A→C with C free, and A-linear equivalences eX:X⊗A→U×A and eY:Y⊗A→U×C such that eY((f⊗A)(x))=((eX(x)).1,g((eX(x)).2)) for every x. No kernel or cokernel comparison is assumed.

source.place: Tags 00NX and 00O0, finite-projective local freeness and unit-minor proof; rank-(n-1) adaptation by K2.

proof.text: Over A=R_p, finite projectivity gives finite freeness. This can be obtained directly from Mathlib Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing, since base change preserves finiteness and projectivity implies flatness. Choose finite bases. Tensor associativity identifies the residue matrix of f⊗A with f⊗κ.

If n is the source rank, rank-nullity over κ and the hypothesis show n≥1 and rank n-1. Choose n-1 independent columns and n-1 rows giving a nonsingular square minor. Its determinant lifts to a unit of A because its residue is nonzero. Permute those coordinates to the front.

Write the matrix [[B,b],[D,d]]. The source operation s(u,a)=(u-B⁻¹ba,a) and target operation t(y,z)=(B⁻¹y,z-DB⁻¹y) give t f s = diag(id,g), where g(a)=(d-DB⁻¹b)a. Let eX be s⁻¹ composed with the source coordinates and eY be t composed with the target coordinates. U is the selected coordinate module and C the remaining target coordinates, so C is free. Reversing the operations gives the inverses. When n=1, U=0 and B is empty; no inverse of a nonempty minor is needed.

theorem residue_kernel_unit_minor_normal_form
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfX : Module.Finite R X) (hfY : Module.Finite R Y)
    (hpX : Module.Projective R X) (hpY : Module.Projective R Y)
    (𝔭 : Ideal R) [𝔭.IsPrime]
    (hres : Nonempty (LinearMap.ker ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
      ((IsLocalRing.residue (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)).comp
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)))).map f).hom
      ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)]
        IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))) :
    ∃ (U C : ModuleCat.{v} (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))
      (g : Localization.AtPrime 𝔭 →ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭] C),
      Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭) C ∧
      ∃ (eX : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).obj X)
          ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭] (U × Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))
        (eY : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).obj Y)
          ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭] (U × C)),
        ∀ x, eY (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).map f).hom
          x) = ((eX x).1, g (eX x).2)
